references.text: The tribe of Dan was mustered during the census in the wilderness, showing the tribe's continuity from the wilderness journey to the land distribution.
The second census of the tribe of Dan before entering Canaan, showing the size of the tribe when leaders were appointed to distribute the land.
Dan's birth as a son of Jacob through Bilah, which is the origin of the tribe of Dan.
The description of the territory assigned to the tribe of Dan, resulting from the work of the chiefs appointed in Num 34.
The introduction to the list of chiefs who were to distribute the land, where Bukki ben Jogli is one of those appointed.
